sections.Profile:
The "Eros One" and "Flame of Athens" pinball machines, both produced by Allied Leisure Industries Inc. in 1978, share a cocktail table design and are nearly identical in features. These solid-state electronic games each accommodate up to two players and include two flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, four drop targets, and three standup targets.

- Manufacturer: Allied Leisure Industries Inc.
- Years made: 1978–1979
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
